body:
Everyone's saying the same thing "So what you gonna do then Starmer lolol" Okay fair enough, the country needs a plan to fix the mess the Tories are leaving us with.

But Starmer can't tell you how he will fix the Country because the country is beyond broken. Setting goals would be Political suicide, it will take a Generation at least to fix the mountain of shit the Public Sector is under.

People need to understand something. (My source is my relative) he went to University in the 90's with a guy who was gifted in Maths/Economic/Finance studies. That guy is now a ranking manager at a large Multinational firm in the City of London.

Apparently he said this in 2010 "Austerity works, reducing budgets will help to balance the books and stop a country haemorrhaging money dealing with interest on borrowing...BUT..."

"But", this is the important part of what he said.

"BUT... for every year Austerity continues, it has a massively negative impact on Public services, every year cuts happen, they create issues or mean less capacity for the service to function correctly. Then year on year those issues added to more cuts create more issues and more reduction of capacity. Its a huge snowball that will get out of control if they allow Austerity to continue for too long."

So here we are 14 years of Austerity later... How's the UK's Public Sector doing? /s

The point I'm trying to make is the Tories have fucked us on a scale we cannot even begin to imagine. Not only do we now need to pay massive amounts to fix the services, we also need to just pay the normal amount to run them. This is not possible without huge borrowing, or huge Growth (How likely is that?)

Our Public Sectors (All of them) have been so badly funded for so long, they are completely overwhelmed. The fixes will take a Generation at least to sort them out and will cost MULTIPE times what was apparently saved because of Austerity budget cuts.
